method: Visual audit at 40, 20 and 16 CSS px; risk judgements, not measured player confusion rates.

proposals.shape: The same two-bar stack as silver; pale blue only separates it by colour.
proposals.colourValue: Blue-silver and white, both bright at chip size.
proposals.lore: Lighter-than-air fragments held around a gravitational core.

proposals.shape: Single pale bar still reads as the same ingot family at 16 px.
proposals.colourValue: Dark side loses area; the bright top dominates.
proposals.lore: Chilled metallic ore with a thirst for warmth.

proposals.shape: Both silica and ice are compact many-sided pale chunks.
proposals.colourValue: White/cyan high-value mass; fine refraction disappears.

proposals.shape: Both are upright purple crystal clusters; the amber tips carry most of the difference.
proposals.colourValue: Purple midtone body with tiny bright tips.
proposals.lore: Crystal imprisoned inside a timeless geode.

proposals.shape: The rolled hide becomes another diagonal cylinder with a bright round end.
proposals.colourValue: Warm brown/red overlap; scales disappear at 16 px.
proposals.lore: The resource lore describes a fallen dragon scale.

proposals.shape: T2 and T3 share a steel helmet and shoulder triangle; the plume is the main tier cue.
proposals.colourValue: Red mantle exists in all tiers; steel highlights merge.
proposals.lore: Keep a richer armoured knight, with a larger tier silhouette.

proposals.shape: All three have the same crossbow-and-shoulders silhouette.
proposals.colourValue: Brown and green midtones dominate; trim disappears at chip size.
proposals.lore: Keep the crossbowman holding his crossbow; middle tier uses steel over padded cloth.

proposals.shape: Sword, pale tabard and shoulders recur in all tiers; wing detail shrinks away.
proposals.colourValue: White/blue mass with steel highlights in every tier.
proposals.lore: Keep an armoured holy warrior, blue mantle and sun tabard.

proposals.shape: Both tiers use the same narrow stone tablet; tier-two silver corners vanish at 16 px.
proposals.colourValue: The family motif and its colour stay the same, with nearly identical light/dark mass.
proposals.lore: Retain the effect motif; stronger relics gain a visibly wider stone body.

controls.reason: Warm long logs versus dark compact lumps; keep both.
Coal is a low lumpy heap, obsidian is a tall sharp star, ignium carries a large orange interior; keep.
Shared ingot grammar, but copper orange, gold yellow, silver white and adamantine dark green separate by value and hue. Keep these anchors; remove mithral and cold iron from the grammar.
Similar cut-gem forms; saturated red, deep blue and high-value white preserve the gem family. Keep for this pass.
Paired golden logs, single dark red-ended log, and upright sap-bleeding heart cut remain distinguishable. Keep; moving dragonhide out removes the fourth cylinder.
Both include purple liquid, but alchemical silver has a strong horizontal bright bar while essence is a vertical bottle. Keep and retain labels in dense lists.
